blocks.text: NEW ORLEANS— John Collins hit four 3-pointers and scored 20 points to lead seven Detroit players in double figures as the Pistons beat the New Orleans Pelicans 122-109 in the NBA on Wednesday night. Javonte Green added 18 points, Daniss Jenkins had 17 points and nine assists, and Paul Reed also finished with 17 points on 7-of-9 shooting for the Pistons. Cade Cunningham (knee soreness) was listed as questionable but did not play in the second game of a back-to-back.
